name: Tinker beacon charges are restored by effect 187 (#3818)
contract: Rapid Fire Healing's triggered half 805311 carries SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESTORE_SPELL_CHARGES (187) with MiscValue 13 and damage 1, handled at src/server/game/Spells/SpellEffects.cpp:552-561 as RestoreSpellChargeCategory(13, 1). SpellChargesCategory.dbc row 13 is 3 charges with a 15000 ms recharge and SpellCharges.dbc puts Build: Shield Beacon 801799 in it, so spending all three charges leaves Player::GetSpellCooldownDelay reporting the recharge wait, and casting 805311 must clear it immediately. This covers the effect handler only. The talent's 15% roll (AscensionTinkerAbilities.cpp:202-203, ProcChance 15 on 705803) has no deterministic observable: the harness exposes no spell-charge metric, the only proxy is this same cooldown, and the pool recharges on its own within 15 s.

steps.label: The triggered effect hands a beacon charge back
